name: Octamy Grade 3 Arithmetic, Time and Perimeter Practice Bank v1
description: Two hundred first-party questions for a deliberately narrow Grade 3 practice product covering eight skills: whole-number addition, whole-number subtraction, multiplication with factors through 10, exact division within 100, missing-number addition/subtraction equations, halves and fourths of quantities, elapsed time in minutes, and perimeter by adding side lengths. This bank does not claim full Grade 3 curriculum coverage.

provenance.chainOfTitle: Every prompt, option, answer and explanation is authored as first-party Octamy practice content; NCERT is referenced only for broad age-band context and no NCERT exercise text is copied.
provenance.notes: This is an eight-skill practice bank, not a full-curriculum Grade 3 assessment. Registration and validation do not approve or publish it. A named independent mathematics reviewer must record item review before activation.
